fields.value: Work well with PufferLib and Softmax Coworld environments: examples for training and for seating players

Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: "I think we shoudl be open about the idea that etude was built to support manabot, and use it as a flagship example. but otherwise i think we should look at trying to support pufferRL's games and work well with them, as well as softmax's". Asked whether Softmax's meant MettaGrid: "and not mettagrid, coworld". On filing this: "yeah thats fine, it cna be an unstarted task". Not started; it follows EXP-56 and sits near EXP-60.

## Why

Manabot is the flagship example and Etude says so. To be worth adopting by anyone else, Etude has to work with environments people already use. The two named are PufferLib's games and Softmax's Coworld.

## Outcome

1. Read both projects as they are now. Nothing about either was checked when this was filed. From memory only: PufferLib ships its own trainer and vectorised environments, several multi-agent. Coworld was not looked up at all; start by finding what it is and how agents and policies plug into it.
2. Training: a PufferLib training loop wrapped in `train(config)` that runs under `etude run` and `etude launch`, resumes after an interruption, and publishes checkpoints with their clocks. The same for Coworld if it has a training side. Say what the train API was missing, if anything.
3. Evaluation: Etude players seated as the agents of one multi-agent environment from each project, so a benchmark and a report work on it. Say what the evaluation model was missing (more than two seats, teams, a shared policy across seats, scoring that is not win or loss).
4. Both live under `examples/` with their own dependencies. Etude itself gains no dependency on either, and its tests keep their in-repository fixture.

## Constraints

Etude sells no trainer: the example uses the project's own, called from the author's `train`. No induced load in tests. Gaps found in the evaluation model are reported to EXP-60, not patched here.

## Context

Design: `scratch/design-train-api.md` in the EXP-56 worktree (open point 4). Positioning notes: `scratch/positioning.md` in the Manabot worktree `manabot.aa55a0-move-run-execution` (MTG-329).
